analysis: The Wild are 15-3-4 with a +28 goal differential and 8-0-2 in their last 10, the best form in the West. Nashville is 11-5-5 (+5) and lost 4-2 in San Jose on Sunday, ending a seven-game win streak. In goal, Jesper Wallstedt is 14-2-3 with a .926 save percentage against Juuse Saros at .918 (neither confirmed at pick time). Minnesota is without Filip Gustavsson and Olli Maatta; Jonathan Marchessault is day-to-day for Nashville. Books have Minnesota at -186. Saros can steal a game, so the Preds plus the goal and a half is the better side of the puck line. Pretend stakes: $40 on the Wild to win, $30 on Nashville +1.5 at -142.
